name: Asou Yumiko
source:
The daughter of strict Christian parents, Yumiko is presently a third year school student. While she presents herself as an uplifting and cheerful individual, deep in her heart, Yumiko resents her cloistered and oppressed upbringing. She’d like nothing more than to be rid of her current lifestyle.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175338/www.elizar.com/?p=30]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
